render.forceIntro: The Linux launcher bundles Ubuntu's WebKit, which draws without the GPU on every NVIDIA card. This switch lifts that block (WEBKIT_FORCE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1 with shared memory, WEBKIT_DMABUF_RENDERER_FORCE_SHM=1). It is off on clean starts: some NVIDIA drivers crash or show a black window with it. If a normal NVIDIA start fails to paint, the next start may try shared memory once and remember it if it works. Turning this switch off explicitly disables that recovery too. If a shared-memory start fails, the launcher turns it off by itself. Applies at the next start.

render.forceRecovery: The previous normal NVIDIA startup never confirmed a visible frame. This start is trying shared-memory GPU drawing once; a successful visible start is remembered for this installation and display backend.
render.forceRecovered: Shared memory is the last working automatic renderer for this installation and display backend. Turning this switch off disables automatic recovery too.

privacy.never: Nothing is sent until you press a button on a screen that shows what goes.
privacy.signIn: Kiln gets your Discord user ID, name and picture. frostdev.io keeps them while you're signed in. It never gets your email, your password, your messages, your friends or your servers.
privacy.join: If you tick Also join, frostdev.io adds you to the Kiln Discord once, right then.
privacy.reportPublic: In #support, for everyone: your line, your words, the kind of problem, what the report found, the versions, how many mods are on and your Discord name.
privacy.reportTeam: For the Kiln team only, unless you choose otherwise: the report zip. It's deleted from the team's channel after 30 days.
privacy.presence: Only while it's on and you play, and only to the Discord app on this PC: Enshrouded with Kiln, how many mods are on, and the time. Never server or world names, your character, or which mods you use.
privacy.presencePack: With Show my Crucible pack on, also the name of the Crucible pack you play and a link to its page on frostdev.io. Packs made on this PC are never named.
privacy.testerTitle: When you volunteer as a tester
privacy.tester: The Kiln team gets this PC's graphics card, driver, video memory, system and how the game runs. Your results go to the build's post in #testing. A support report you attach goes to the team only.
privacy.kept: A fingerprint of your sign-in, until you sign out or for 90 days unused. Your Discord ID with the list of your posts, so the launcher can show their replies. Your name and picture while you're signed in. Your hardware if you test. A Deck's sign-in code and the network it came from, for 10 minutes. Counts for the sending limits, for a day. A post leaves the list 90 days after it's solved or closed, and Sign out and forget me deletes all of it at once. Report zips are never stored on frostdev.io.
privacy.undo: Sign out. Sign out and forget me. Delete a post from its menu. Stop testing. Turn Rich Presence off.
privacy.forgetText: frostdev.io deletes your name, your ID, your hardware, the list of your posts and the Kiln team's copies of your report zips. Your posts stay on Discord until you delete them.
